items.contentSnippet:

Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50120224
Points: 292
# Comments: 192
items.creator: farlight

summaries.zh: JPEG XL和AVIF是两种用于网络应用的高效图像格式。JPEG XL提供无损和有损压缩选项，支持高级功能如嵌套和透明度；AVIF则专注于高质量有损压缩，同样支持透明度和动画。两者均旨在替代JPEG，但JPEG XL在功能上更全面。目前两者生态和兼容性仍在发展中。
summaries.en: JPEG XL and AVIF are emerging image formats designed for web use. JPEG XL offers high-quality compression and support for 16-bit color depth, while AVIF provides advanced features like spatial and temporal compression. Both aim to improve web image efficiency, reducing data size without compromising quality. However, AVIF is gaining traction due to broader adoption, while JPEG XL is backed by major tech companies. The choice between them depends on compatibility, performance, and specific use cases. Both formats represent significant advancements in web imaging.

summaries.zh: 国际计量局决定停止为协调世界时（UTC）增加闰秒。这一决议将在2026年国际计量大会（CGPM）上正式通过。此举旨在简化时间系统，减少人为干预，提高全球时间同步的稳定性。
summaries.en: The International Bureau of Weights and Measures (BIPM) has decided to cease adding leap seconds to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) starting in 2035. This decision aims to simplify timekeeping and reduce disruptions caused by leap seconds. The decision was approved by the 27th Conference Generale des Poids et Mesures (CGPM) in 2026. The change will ensure greater stability for global time synchronization systems. No further details were provided on the implementation or potential impacts.
